hero.title: Is The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Good for People Who Do Not Like Cruises?
hero.subtitle: Discover why travelers who avoid mega-ships thrive in the intimate, unhurried freedom of luxury yachting.
hero.description: Compare the private yacht atmosphere, smaller scale, flexible dining, lack of formal nights, and luxury resort lifestyle for travelers who normally avoid traditional cruises.

executivePhilosophy.title: The Difference Between Disliking Cruises and Disliking Big Ships
paragraphs: Is The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for people who do not like cruises? It can be, especially for travelers who dislike traditional cruises because of large ships, crowds, formal nights, scheduled group activities, or a busy onboard atmosphere.

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is designed around a private-yacht-style experience rather than a conventional large-ship cruise experience. Its yachts feature all-suite accommodations with private terraces, personalized Suite Ambassador service, multiple dining venues, premium beverages, onboard gratuities, Wi-Fi and marina-style access to watersports.
However, it is still a yacht voyage. You will still travel by sea, visit multiple ports, follow an itinerary and return to the yacht after spending time ashore.

So the better question is not simply: 'Do I like cruises?' It is: 'What do I dislike about traditional cruises, and does the Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection address those specific concerns?' For many cruise-averse travelers, that distinction is important.
executivePhilosophy.quote: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection itself describes the experience as combining the luxury lifestyle of Ritz-Carlton with the casual freedom of yachting.

quickAnswerTable.title: Quick Answer: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Good for Non-Cruisers?
quickAnswerTable.lead: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection itself describes the experience as combining the luxury lifestyle of Ritz-Carlton with the casual freedom of yachting. Its current materials emphasize relaxed elegance rather than formal cruise conventions.

whyNonCruisersLikeIt.title: Why People Who Dislike Cruises May Like Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection
whyNonCruisersLikeIt.subtitle: Not everyone who says 'I don't like cruises' dislikes being on the water. Often, they dislike specific aspects of conventional cruising. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection approaches several of these elements differently.

pillars.title: Escape Mega-Ships & Crowds
pillars.description: No thousands of passengers, no endless hallways, and no feeling of being trapped on a massive floating resort.

pillars.title: No Buffets or Assigned Dining
pillars.description: Dine whenever and with whomever you choose across multiple open-seating venues or enjoy 24-hour in-suite service.

pillars.title: Zero Formal Nights
pillars.description: No mandatory tuxedos, gowns, or rigid packing lists. The evening standard is relaxed 'Yacht Sophisticated'.

pillars.title: No Rigid Schedules or Announcements
pillars.description: Enjoy the freedom to shape your day at your own pace without loudspeakers, bingo calls, or forced activities.

traditionalCruiseComparison.title: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Like a Traditional Cruise?
paragraphs: Not exactly, but it is still a cruise-style vacation. This is one of the most important distinctions to make.

Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection still involves: Embarking on a yacht, Sailing between destinations, Following a voyage itinerary, Spending nights onboard, Visiting multiple ports, Returning to the yacht after excursions, and Sharing the yacht with other guests.

So if someone simply does not enjoy being on a vessel at sea, Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection may not solve the underlying issue. But if someone dislikes the traditional cruise environment, the experience may feel substantially different.
features: Embarking and sleeping on a maritime yacht vessel
Sailing between world-class international destinations
Following a defined port itinerary and schedule
Returning to the yacht after shore excursions
Sharing public lounges and decks with other discerning guests
Experiencing ocean conditions and nautical travel

crowdsAndScale.title: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Less Crowded Than a Cruise Ship?
crowdsAndScale.subtitle: The experience is designed around a much smaller yacht environment than the mega-ship model used by mainstream cruise lines. That difference can matter for travelers who dislike:

features.title: Crowded Pool Decks
features.description: Designed around an intimate, uncrowded yacht environment with spacious oceanview relaxation and no lounge chair competition.

features.title: Large Dining Rooms
features.description: Multiple boutique open-seating venues with no assigned tables, rigid seatings, or cavernous banquet halls.

features.title: Massive Entertainment Venues
features.description: Understated live jazz, acoustic performances, and enrichment rather than crowded stadium-scale arena productions.

features.title: Long Lines
features.description: Seamless personal service across the yacht with zero buffet congestion or gangway disembarkation bottlenecks.

features.title: Busy Embarkation Environments
features.description: Relaxed yacht boarding with dedicated personal Suite Ambassador greetings and direct suite escorts.

features.title: Large Organized Activities
features.description: Complete personal freedom to structure your days independently with zero loudspeaker announcements or forced group games.

crowdsAndScale.summary: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection's current materials emphasize an intimate, personalized yachting experience with all-suite accommodations and dedicated Suite Ambassador service. For someone who associates cruising with a large floating resort, this can create a very different first impression.

hotelVsYachtPhilosophy.title: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Feel Like a Hotel?
hotelVsYachtPhilosophy.subtitle: For some travelers, this is one of the strongest reasons to consider it. The experience combines elements of luxury hotel + private yacht + destination travel.

sailing.label: Luxury Hotel & Resort Lifestyle
points: Every suite features an ocean-view private terrace
Multiple fine dining venues & 24-hr in-suite service
Premium beverages, Starlink Wi-Fi & crew gratuities included
Feels closer to a luxury resort that moves between ports

allSuite.label: Yacht Operational Reality
points: Still operates as a maritime sailing vessel
Follows scheduled port arrivals and departures
Requires adhering to all-aboard gangway times
Subject to ocean weather and water motion
Fundamentally different from a stationary land resort

hotelVsYachtPhilosophy.verdict: It combines elements of: Luxury hotel + private yacht + destination travel. That can make the experience feel closer to staying at a luxury resort that happens to move between destinations. But it is important not to overstate the comparison. It is still a yacht, and the itinerary and operating environment are fundamentally different from a land-based hotel.

formalNightsAndDressCode.subtitle: Enjoy an elegant luxury vacation without needing to pack formalwear for a designated formal night.

cards.title: No Formal Nights
items: No black-tie, tuxedos, or evening gowns required
No captain's formal dinner requirements
Relaxed and effortless luxury packing
Casual comfort throughout daytime sailing

cards.title: Evening 'Yacht Sophisticated'

Jackets and ties are optional, not mandatory

Sophisticated yet relaxed evening ambiance

relaxationAndActivities.title: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Relaxed? Do You Have to Participate in Activities?
relaxationAndActivities.subtitle: Yes. Relaxed elegance is a central part of the positioning. You do not have to fill your day with organized activities.

items.title: Leisure in Your Private Suite
items.description: Spend peaceful hours reading on your private terrace, enjoying 24-hour in-suite dining, or resting in customized luxury bedding.
features: Private ocean-view terrace on every suite
24-hour complimentary in-suite dining
Custom luxury linens and marble bathrooms
Personalized Suite Ambassador assistance
items.highlight: Ideal for introverted luxury travelers seeking restorative quiet without group interaction.

items.title: Casual Onboard Wellness & Pool
items.description: Enjoy uncrowded infinity pool loungers, visit The Ritz-Carlton Spa, or take a drink at the open-air Observation Lounge.
features: Uncrowded pool and whirlpool deck spaces
Full-service Ritz-Carlton Spa and salon treatments
State-of-the-art fitness center with ocean views
Marina platform water sports access when anchored
items.highlight: Shape your wellness and relaxation schedule entirely on your own terms.

items.title: Independent Destination Time
items.description: Go ashore for a guided shore excursion, hire a private Mercedes driver, stroll boutique port villages, or simply stay onboard.
features: Optional Select Group and Private excursions
Freedom to explore coastal towns independently
Complimentary port shuttle in select destinations
No penalty for staying onboard during port days
items.highlight: Complete flexibility to participate in curated tours or wander coastal cobblestones solo.

entertainmentPhilosophy.title: Is It Good for People Who Hate Cruise Entertainment?
entertainmentPhilosophy.text: It may be. Travelers who dislike traditional cruise entertainment often prefer a more understated environment. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection includes onboard entertainment and enrichment, but the overall experience is positioned around luxury yachting rather than the large-scale entertainment model associated with mega-cruise ships. You are not required to attend every performance or organized event. For many luxury travelers, the appeal is having the option of entertainment without making it the central focus of the vacation.

diningDeepDive.title: What About Dining? Flexible, Multi-Venue & 24-Hour Room Service
diningDeepDive.subtitle: Dining can be another major difference for travelers who dislike conventional cruising. No assigned tables, no massive buffets, and no rigid dinner seatings.

items.title: Multiple Open-Seating Restaurants
items.shortDesc: Flexible dining across diverse culinary venues.
items.description: Dine when you want and with whom you want across diverse culinary venues celebrating destination-influenced flavors without assigned tables or rigid seatings.
highlights: Open seating across main dining restaurants

items.title: 24-Hour In-Suite Dining
items.description: For someone who dislikes social or scheduled cruise dining, enjoy breakfast, dinner, or late-night bites on your private terrace in complete seclusion.

items.title: Included Premium Beverages
items.shortDesc: Fine wines, spirits, and cocktails included.
items.description: Fine wines, champagne, craft cocktails, spirits, beers, soft drinks, and specialty coffees included throughout the yacht without beverage package stress.

items.title: Specialty Dining Experiences
items.description: For milestone culinary celebrations, experience world-class dining such as Chef Sven Elverfeld's S.E.A. venue for an elevated fine-dining journey.

takeaway.title: A Modern Luxury Dining Philosophy
takeaway.content: Food preferences are subjective, but the dining model appeals to travelers who want variety, privacy, and flexibility instead of treating every meal as a traditional cruise dining-room experience.

excursionsAndSchedules.title: What If You Don't Like Shore Excursions or Rigid Schedules?
excursionsAndSchedules.subtitle: Navigating destination time and voyage scheduling with realistic expectations.

cards.title: What If You Don't Like Shore Excursions?
items: You do not have to book a shore excursion in any port.
Book guided small-group excursions only when you want vetted access.
Arrange custom private Mercedes drivers and guides through concierge.
Stroll quaint coastal towns independently at your own pace.
Take advantage of complimentary port shuttle buses in select harbors.
Relax onboard and enjoy near-empty pool decks and spa facilities while others are ashore.

cards.title: What If You Don't Like Being on a Schedule?
items: A yacht voyage still has an itinerary with published arrival and departure times.
Guests must track all-aboard times and return to the gangway prior to sailing.
Specialty dining and private tours require advance reservation times.
However, onboard days offer complete freedom with zero mandatory activity schedules.
You set your own wake-up times, dining times, and leisure pacing.

whoShouldNotBook.title: Who May Still Not Like Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?
whoShouldNotBook.subtitle: This is just as important as understanding who might enjoy it. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection may not be the right fit if you strongly dislike:

pillars.title: 1. Being at Sea
pillars.description: If the basic idea of sleeping on a yacht and traveling over open water bothers you, luxury accommodations cannot change that reality.

pillars.title: 2. Voyage Schedules
pillars.description: You still have to follow the yacht's published itinerary, port arrival times, and mandatory all-aboard departure hours.

pillars.title: 3. Sharing With Other Guests
pillars.description: Although the environment is intimate (~298 to 448 guests), it is not a private yacht unless you arrange a full charter.

pillars.title: 4. Motion on the Water
pillars.description: If you are particularly sensitive to motion or seasickness, discuss the itinerary and vessel stabilizers with an advisor.

pillars.title: 5. Port Days & Changing Ports
pillars.description: If you prefer spending an entire vacation at a single stationary resort without moving, a cruise voyage is not ideal.

comparisonVsTraditionalCruise.title: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection vs. Traditional Large Cruise
comparisonVsTraditionalCruise.lead: This comparison is not intended to suggest that one format is universally better. The important question is which environment matches the traveler's preferences.

comparisonVsLuxuryResort.title: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection vs. a Luxury Resort
comparisonVsLuxuryResort.lead:
For someone who says, 'I don't like cruises,' this may actually be the more useful comparison.

If the traveler wants one beautiful location with no sailing, a luxury resort may be a better format. If they want multiple destinations without changing hotels, the yacht becomes more compelling.

whatMakesItDifferent.title: What Makes Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Different? Is It a Good First Cruise?
paragraphs: The fundamental difference is the philosophy behind the experience. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is designed to combine: Luxury hospitality + yachting + destination travel.

The cruise line's current materials emphasize spacious suites, personalized service, flexible days, destination immersion, multiple dining choices and a relaxed yachting atmosphere. That is why the product can appeal to travelers who would not normally identify themselves as 'cruise people.'
For a traveler who is hesitant about cruising, it may be worth considering as a first cruise if the reason for avoiding cruises is the traditional cruise environment rather than being at sea itself.

A first-time cruiser will appreciate: a smaller-yacht environment, all-suite accommodations, private terraces, personalized service, no formal nights, included premium beverages, included Wi-Fi, 24-hour in-suite dining, and flexible destination experiences. But the traveler should still understand that it is a yacht voyage before booking.

decisionFrameworkRoadmap.title: How to Decide If Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Is Right for You
decisionFrameworkRoadmap.subtitle: Ask yourself these 7 core questions to evaluate whether a luxury yacht matches your travel style:

steps.title: Do I dislike large crowds?
steps.description: If yes, a smaller yacht environment of 298–448 guests may appeal to you far more than a 4,000-passenger mega-ship.

steps.title: Do I dislike formal cruise nights?
steps.description: There are no formal nights. The dress standard is relaxed Yacht Sophisticated with zero mandatory black-tie attire.

steps.title: Do I dislike traditional cruise entertainment?
steps.description: The experience is centered around understated luxury yachting, destination immersion, and live acoustic/jazz music.

steps.title: Do I dislike assigned or rigid dining?
steps.description: The yacht offers multiple open-seating restaurants, casual al fresco venues, and 24-hour complimentary in-suite dining.

steps.title: Do I dislike being on the ocean?
steps.description: This remains a yacht voyage that sails over open water. If you dislike water travel, consider a luxury land-based resort instead.

steps.title: Do I want to visit multiple destinations?
steps.description: That is one of the major advantages of yacht travel—unpacking once while visiting picturesque ports and islands.

steps.title: Do I want a luxury hotel atmosphere?
steps.description: All-suite accommodations, private terraces, and Suite Ambassador service provide a much closer fit to a 5-star hotel than a cruise.

questionsToAskAdvisor.title: 12 Questions to Ask Before Booking
questionsToAskAdvisor.subtitle: If you have never cruised—or actively dislike cruises—review these parameters with your travel advisor:

cards.title: Itinerary, Motion & Atmosphere
items: 1. What is the typical atmosphere on this specific itinerary?
2. How much time will we spend at sea versus in port?
3. How long are the port calls, and are there overnight stays?
4. How much water movement might we experience on this route?
5. Which yacht in the fleet (Evrima, Ilma, Luminara) best matches our style?
6. Would a yacht voyage or a luxury land resort better match our vacation goal?

cards.title: Suites, Inclusions & Shoreside Time
items: 7. Which suite category and deck location would suit us best?
8. What dining reservations should we make in advance (e.g. S.E.A.)?
9. Which shore experiences are worth considering versus exploring on our own?
10. Can we explore independently in the ports without guided tours?
11. What is included in the fare and what carries an extra charge?
12. What single supplement or promotion applies for solo travelers?

bentoItems.title: Private Yacht Charters
bentoItems.description: Fully private yacht charters offering bespoke itineraries, complete seclusion, and dedicated personal culinary staff.

advisorValue.takeaway: The goal should not be to put every traveler on a cruise. The goal is to identify the travel style that best fits the person.

angelaPerspective.name: Angela Hughes
angelaPerspective.title: CEO, Trips & Ships Luxury Travel | Founder, Luxury Travel University
angelaPerspective.heading: 40+ Years of Luxury Cruise & Yachting Expertise
angelaPerspective.bio: Angela Hughes is an internationally recognized luxury travel advisor with over four decades of industry leadership. Specializing in luxury cruises, private yachts, and bespoke international itineraries, Angela helps discerning travelers identify the exact vacation style that matches their lifestyle.
angelaPerspective.text: When clients tell me 'I don't like cruises,' my first question is always 'What part of cruising do you dislike?' If they dislike crowds, buffets, formal nights, and rigid schedules, The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is often a revelation—it feels like a 5-star boutique resort that happens to float between world-class harbors. But if they truly dislike being on the ocean, I guide them toward exceptional land-based resorts instead. Experienced advice ensures you never spend vacation time on the wrong format.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for people who don't like cruises?
faqs.answer: It can be, particularly for travelers who dislike large ships, crowds, formal nights or traditional cruise entertainment. It is still a yacht voyage, so travelers who dislike being at sea may prefer a land-based luxury vacation.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection like a traditional cruise?
faqs.answer: It is a cruise-style voyage, but its product is positioned around a smaller, luxury-yacht environment rather than a conventional mega-cruise experience.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection crowded?
faqs.answer: The yacht experience is designed around a smaller-scale environment (298 to 448 guests) and personalized service rather than the large-ship cruise model.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection have formal nights?
faqs.answer: No. The current dress code does not include formal nights. Evening attire is described as Yacht Sophisticated (collared shirts and elegant resortwear; jackets optional).

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current fare includes all-suite accommodations, dining, premium beverages, onboard gratuities, Starlink Wi-Fi and other onboard amenities. Some specialty experiences and services are additional.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection have 24-hour room service?
faqs.answer: Yes. 24-hour in-suite dining is included in the cruise fare.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection include drinks?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current fare includes a selection of premium beverages, including wines, spirits, cocktails, mocktails, beer, soft drinks and specialty coffees and teas.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection include Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Starlink Wi-Fi is included according to the current fare information.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions included?
faqs.answer: Generally no. Shore excursions are optional and separately charged, although select port shuttle transportation may be complimentary.

faqs.question: Can I relax onboard instead of taking excursions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests can choose how they spend their time, including relaxing onboard rather than participating in a shore excursion.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for first-time cruisers?
faqs.answer: It can be a good introduction for travelers who are comfortable being at sea but prefer a luxury yacht environment over a traditional large cruise ship.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for couples?
faqs.answer: It can be a good fit for couples who want luxury accommodations, multiple destinations, personalized service, flexible dining and a relaxed yachting environment.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: It can work well for couples who want to combine luxury accommodations with multiple destinations, although couples who dislike being at sea should also consider a luxury land-based honeymoon.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for families?
faqs.answer: It can be appropriate for families who prefer a sophisticated, smaller-scale luxury environment. The specific itinerary and yacht should be evaluated based on the family's ages and interests.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for solo travelers?
faqs.answer: It can be, although solo travelers should review the applicable single supplement and current fare structure before booking.

faqs.question: What if I hate cruises because I get seasick?
faqs.answer: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection cannot eliminate motion at sea. Travelers who are concerned about seasickness should discuss itinerary, cabin location and other considerations with a travel professional before booking.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection more like a hotel or cruise?
faqs.answer: It combines elements of both. The all-suite accommodations, personalized service and luxury hospitality can feel hotel-like, while the moving itinerary and port visits are characteristic of yacht cruising.

faqs.question: Can you charter a Ritz-Carlton yacht?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection states that its yachts are available for full private charter.

finalAnswer.title: Final Answer: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Good for People Who Do Not Like Cruises?
finalAnswer.lead: It can be an excellent option for travelers who dislike the traditional cruise experience but are open to traveling by yacht.
paragraphs: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection offers a different style of vacation centered around: All-suite accommodations, Private terraces, Personalized service, Premium beverages, Multiple dining venues, 24-hour in-suite dining, Included Wi-Fi, No formal nights, Marina-style watersports, Destination-focused itineraries, and a more relaxed yachting atmosphere.

But it is important to be honest about the trade-off: If you dislike large cruise ships, Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection may address many of your concerns. If you dislike being on the ocean, it may not.
That distinction is the key to deciding whether this type of luxury yacht vacation is right for you.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for people who don't like cruises?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be, particularly for travelers who dislike large ships, crowds, formal nights or traditional cruise entertainment. It is still a yacht voyage, so travelers who dislike being at sea may prefer a land-based luxury vacation.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection like a traditional cruise?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a cruise-style voyage, but its product is positioned around a smaller, luxury-yacht environment rather than a conventional mega-cruise experience.
The yacht experience is designed around a smaller-scale environment (298 to 448 guests) and personalized service rather than the large-ship cruise model.

mainEntity.name: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection have formal nights?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The current dress code does not include formal nights. Evening attire is described as Yacht Sophisticated (collared shirts and elegant resortwear; jackets optional).

Yes. The current fare includes all-suite accommodations, dining, premium beverages, onboard gratuities, Starlink Wi-Fi and other onboard amenities. Some specialty experiences and services are additional.

mainEntity.name: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection have 24-hour room service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. 24-hour in-suite dining is included in the cruise fare.

mainEntity.name: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection include drinks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The current fare includes a selection of premium beverages, including wines, spirits, cocktails, mocktails, beer, soft drinks and specialty coffees and teas.

mainEntity.name: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection include Wi-Fi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Complimentary Starlink Wi-Fi is included according to the current fare information.

mainEntity.name: Can I relax onboard instead of taking excursions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Guests can choose how they spend their time, including relaxing onboard rather than participating in a shore excursion.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for first-time cruisers?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be a good introduction for travelers who are comfortable being at sea but prefer a luxury yacht environment over a traditional large cruise ship.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for couples?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be a good fit for couples who want luxury accommodations, multiple destinations, personalized service, flexible dining and a relaxed yachting environment.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for honeymooners?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can work well for couples who want to combine luxury accommodations with multiple destinations, although couples who dislike being at sea should also consider a luxury land-based honeymoon.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for families?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be appropriate for families who prefer a sophisticated, smaller-scale luxury environment. The specific itinerary and yacht should be evaluated based on the family's ages and interests.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for solo travelers?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be, although solo travelers should review the applicable single supplement and current fare structure before booking.

mainEntity.name: What if I hate cruises because I get seasick?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection cannot eliminate motion at sea. Travelers who are concerned about seasickness should discuss itinerary, cabin location and other considerations with a travel professional before booking.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection more like a hotel or cruise?

acceptedAnswer.text: It combines elements of both. The all-suite accommodations, personalized service and luxury hospitality can feel hotel-like, while the moving itinerary and port visits are characteristic of yacht cruising.

mainEntity.name: Can you charter a Ritz-Carlton yacht?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection states that its yachts are available for full private charter.
